description: Active listings as JSON. No query returns every listing, in the same order as before. Optional query parameters: limit, offset, q, since, and category. q matches the title, description, or URL. since is an ISO timestamp; listings created at or after it are kept. category is a slug from list_categories and filters to that group or leaf. Each listing includes created_at and a category object ({slug, name, group}) or null while the listing is unclassified.

category.description: A category slug from list_categories — a group or a promoted leaf.

limit.description: Max listings. 50 with offset, 100 with q, when omitted.

offset.description: How many matching listings to skip.

q.description: Substring of the title, description, or URL.

since.description: ISO timestamp. Keep listings created at or after this moment.

name: list_listings
